whyCopy: Sonido runs its own events on the same equipment we hire out. That means we know what a warehouse actually needs, how much power a system draws, and what goes wrong at 3am.

So when you hire from us you are not just getting a box of gear. Ask us what size system your room needs, where the speakers should go, or whether the power will hold. We have probably dealt with it already.

services.heading: Delivery, setup and pack down
services.copy: We bring the equipment to your venue, set it up, test it and pack it down afterwards. Quoted on enquiry depending on location.

services.heading: Consultations and site visits
services.copy: Not sure what you need? We can talk it through or come and look at the space first. Room size, speaker placement, and whether the power will hold.

services.heading: Someone on the night
services.copy: One of us stays for the event to run the sound, keep levels right and sort out anything that comes up.

terms.heading: Hire period
terms.copy: All prices are for a 24 hour hire. Longer periods are available on request.

terms.heading: Collection, delivery and setup
terms.copy: Collection from us is standard. We can also deliver, set up and pack down, quoted at the time of enquiry depending on location.

terms.heading: Bond
terms.copy: A bond equal to the hire price, refunded once the equipment is returned undamaged. Photo ID is taken at collection and deleted on return.

terms.heading: Availability
